title: CW-PACK40 4-Bit Header Plus 36-Bit Path
negative_results: a header value exceeding the 4-bit field (0..15) is refused, not truncated
a path value exceeding the 36-bit field (0..2**36-1) is refused, not truncated
negative header or path values are refused
booleans and non-integers are refused (not silently coerced)
a packed word outside the 40-bit range is refused
an octal path string that is not exactly twelve base-8 digits is refused
refuse_as_geographic() always raises: a packed word is never a location

claims.statement: CW-PACK40-1 reversibly packs a 4-bit header and a 36-bit path (twelve octal digits) into a 40-bit word; encode/decode is an exact POWER round-trip.
The codec output is an arithmetic re-expression of two integers and never a geographic decode; a legacy decode yields zero, one, or many candidates, never a forced pin.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
